Run everything through `lky` (on PATH while this plugin is enabled; it is `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lky`): `lky backends`, `lky new work/<name>`, and any tool with `lky run <tool> ...` (`lky run subtitles.py rec.mkv > rec.srt`). `lky` uses the toolkit's own Python venv and creates it on first use; install missing packages into it with `lky pip install <package>`, never system-wide. When a feature needs a package that isn't installed, install it or use an alternative (`${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/AGENTS.md`, "Python packages and optional features"); ask instead if the person prefers to be asked.

Worked examples (read one that is close to the request and adapt it; they are not rules):

- `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/flows/edit-recording.md` (ready): The person recorded a video (screencast, talk) and wants it edited and ready to publish (YouTube, social posts, a project page).

- `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/flows/long-to-shorts.md` (ready): Make vertical Shorts (9:16, word-by-word captions) from the best moments of a long video.
